features.py:52 cites ISO 7045 (cross-recess pan head, dk max 6.0). bd has no ISO 7045 table: its pan data is ISO 14583 (Torx) and ISO 1580 (slotted), both 5.6 at M3. A different standard, not a contradiction. M2/M2.5/M4/M5 agree with 14583 because the standards coincide there. Cutter-side, a larger dk only widens the counterbore.

ISO 7046 actual dk max at M3 is about 5.5 (issue #37), bd lists 5.6; ours 6.0 is above both and has no citation (RULES overlay comment: '90 deg countersunk'). Standard supports theirs. SIZES not changed in this PR; follow-up decides whether the 0.4 mm margin is wanted.
